subject: Micro-theater routing & printed assets — finalizing layouts
messages:
From: CloudConf Events <events@cloudconf.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Moscone Exhibitor Services <exhibitor@moscone.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Booth A12 - micro-theater placement and ingress/egress routing

Hi Alex,

Thanks for confirming Redwood's booth at CloudConf — excited to have you in Hall B. A couple of follow-ups from our side after reviewing the floor plan:

- The micro-theater cluster (near A12) shares the main aisle with two sponsor islands. We need a final visitor-flow plan to avoid congestion during the 11:30–13:30 lunch peak.
- Fire marshal wants an explicit 48" clear path from the loading corridor to the nearest aisle; the attached plan you sent earlier shows a narrower gap.
- Print vendor needs final callouts for the 6x2 hanging sign and three foam-core routing signs by Friday to meet their production schedule.

Can you send a quick sketch of the proposed micro-theater entry/exit and confirm whether you want the printed welcome panel to be left- or right-facing? If you have a preferred time, we can loop in Exhibitor Services for a brief site walk on Tuesday.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Event Coordinator, CloudConf Events

--
Attachment: initial_hallB_overview.pdf (map, 1.2MB stub)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: CloudConf Events <events@cloudconf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Moscone Exhibitor Services <exhibitor@moscone.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth A12 - micro-theater placement and ingress/egress routing

Thanks Alyssa — quick response with our plan below.

Summary: we propose a unidirectional visitor flow through the micro-theater (enter from the main aisle, exit onto the side aisle) with a 60" circulation lane maintained for the busiest hours. This keeps the loading corridor clear and should satisfy the marshal.

Planned layout notes:
- Micro-theater entrance on the north side (closest to A12 main entrance) with a single queue lane and stanchions.
- Exit to the east side that disperses traffic away from the sponsor islands.
- Left-facing welcome panel (facing incoming traffic) so badge-scanners and demo hosts are on the right for crowd control.

Action items:
- Marissa: can you confirm we have 3x foam-core signs and one 6x2 hanging sign in the print order?
- Marcus: confirm staff rotation so we always have two hosts at the micro-theater during 11:30–13:30 and 15:00–16:00 peaks.
- Marissa/Marcus: if you agree, I’ll send the updated floor plan to PrintPro today for production.

I’m available at 2pm PT for the virtual site walk if Exhibitor Services is free — otherwise Tuesday morning on-site works.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Partnerships & Field Events, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment referenced: booth_floor_2x3_v3.pdf (updated floor plan, v3)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, CloudConf Events <events@cloudconf.com>, PrintPro Graphics <orders@printpro.com>, Moscone Exhibitor Services <exhibitor@moscone.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth A12 - micro-theater placement and ingress/egress routing

Love the unidirectional flow — cleaner for crowding. Quick checklist & decisions needed from the team: 

1) Print order: I’ve attached the print_assets_order.csv with quantities. Confirm ASAP so PrintPro can hit Friday production.
   - 3 foam-core directional signs (18x24)
   - 1 welcome panel (24x48 foam-core) — left-facing
   - 1 hanging banner (72x24 fabric)

2) Micro-theater schedule (microtheater_schedule.xlsx attached): propose 20-minute rotations every 30 minutes between 10:00–17:00; this gives staff 10 minutes to reset and reduces queue build-up. Agree?

3) Fire marshal: Booth gap check — per Exhibitor Services note, we need to gap the demo table 4" farther from the rear wall. Marcus, can your build team notch the base plate by 4"?

4) On-site monitoring: Evelyn, can you pick up the 10:30–12:00 midday shift? We’ll need a headcount tracker at the entrance (badge scanner) and a manual tally sheet as fallback.

Please reply with "Approve prints / Approve schedule" or highlight any redlines. If we don’t hear back by EOD Friday I’ll approve the production run to avoid delays.

Thanks — attaching: print_assets_order.csv, microtheater_schedule.xlsx, booth_floor_2x3_v3.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: print_assets_order.csv (stubbing order), microtheater_schedule.xlsx (rotations), booth_floor_2x3_v3.pdf (v3 with marshal notes)
